decisions: Reconciled PM-owned acceptance, requirements and priorities with D30 and the current static hybrid candidate. Product scope P01-P11 remains unchanged.

D30 serves all 12 Astro-generated static content routes by default through Next rewrites. Next retains contact API, response headers, error handling and rollback rendering via PORTFOLIO_STATIC_PILOT=0; pnpm build generates static output.

Current evidence records G3 satisfied: clean build; 46 unit tests; 202 browser checks passed with 2 expected skips across Chromium/WebKit at 390/1440; SEO audit has zero findings; security and dependency audit pass; all 12 route/device Lighthouse checks pass with all categories 100.
A17 is verified: mobile LCP 1356-1359ms, desktop LCP 327-329ms, and every measured CLS is below 0.1. A18 is verified against the clean candidate security/runtime evidence and dependency audit.
A07 is verified by the production no-provider regression test: no Resend configuration with CONTACT_DRY_RUN=0 returns direct-email fallback and does not construct Resend.

S7 remains pending: deployment and post-deploy URL/SEO checks; owner-controlled provider configuration and receipts if providers are enabled; BusinessOS connection and separate approval steps; launch video and /learn memory. Custom domain remains deferred.
Linux static snapshot baseline and remote CI portability both passed in GitHub Actions run 36373755566; all 48 Linux static snapshots are committed.
risks: No deployment is evidenced; deployment URL and post-deploy checks remain S7 work.
Real email/telemetry provider receipts require owner-controlled release configuration; no-provider fallback/no-op behavior is verified and is not a G3 blocker.
BusinessOS live-site dogfood and launch video remain S7 work. The /learn build memory exists, but owner rating and qualitative feedback are pending.
Preview deployment remains blocked on owner Vercel device authentication; the configured provisional hostname returns 404.
open_questions: Owner-controlled deployment account and provider configuration, if enabled, are needed to complete S7 release evidence. Custom-domain selection remains deferred.
next_instructions: Proceed with S7 deployment and post-deploy URL/SEO/contact smoke checks when deployment access is available; custom domain remains deferred.

Configure only owner-approved production providers if enabled and capture receipts; otherwise retain the verified direct-email fallback and clean monitoring no-op behavior. Never release test credentials or CONTACT_DRY_RUN.

After preview deployment, complete BusinessOS /connect dogfood subject to owner approval for default-branch integration, a PR and separate publish approval; then produce the launch video and complete /learn after owner feedback.
Do not reopen G3 for Linux snapshots; CI run 36373755566 generated and committed all 48 static snapshots.
